title: Pane Grid
purpose: Central area displaying open applications, files, and tools in a hierarchical pane layout
states: empty - no apps open in cluster
split-panes - multiple panes arranged vertically or horizontally
acceptance: shall display apps in their mounted iframes
shall show tab bar for each pane with active tab highlighted
shall allow dragging dividers to resize panes
shall show resizable split handles between panes
shall apply saved pane proportions on restore
shall prevent panes from becoming too small (min 240px)
